guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: bright Plexi crunch with tight attack and raw 70s drive
tone.profile: bright Plexi crunch with tight attack and raw 70s drive
tone.summary: The signal chain uses a Boost for initial tightening, followed by the UK 50 amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet. A Chorus adds subtle movement, while Digital Delay provides rhythmic depth, capturing the raw, bright hard rock sound of Led Zeppelin's era.
corrections: make it brighter and more immediate
less bluesy, more raw hard-rock crunch

rig.name: Led Zeppelin - Rock And Roll - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and tighten the overall tone.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for high-gain modeling.

blocks.purpose: Tighten the attack and provide immediate grit for riffing.
blocks.gap: None. Boost is ideal for adding bite without excessive coloration.

blocks.purpose: Provide raw, aggressive crunch and upper-mid bite characteristic of 70s hard rock.
blocks.gap: The RAT is a general high-gain dirt pedal; while Plexi was specified, the RAT provides the necessary tight aggression and mid-range punch better than other options.

blocks.purpose: Model the classic British Plexi sound (Marshall 1960/Plexi) with bright, raw crunch.
blocks.gap: None. This is the core tone requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British 4x12 cabinet sound required for the genre.
blocks.gap: None. Essential component matching the source material's gear clues.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle movement and width to the overall tone without muddying the riff attack.
blocks.gap: The source material is raw, but a slight chorus can add dimension suitable for solos/fills.

blocks.purpose: Add rhythmic depth and space to the powerful riffs.
blocks.gap: None. Standard enhancement for hard rock leads/riffs.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the natural room ambience of a live PA setting.
blocks.gap: None. Provides necessary space without sounding overly ambient or clean.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more open, raw 4x12 to better capture the live PA/room edge sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance raw, open 70s hard rock tone and room presence.
